{{Name|Hero Elixir}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Forage|forageable]] item that can be obtained by foraging in the Corrupted Lake and Hollow Wood Outskirts areas of [[Crimson Badlands]]. Despite being foraged off the ground, {{PAGENAME}} is classified as [[Stardew:Monster Loot|Monster Loot]]. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {{PAGENAME}} can be found on the ground in several spots on the eastern side of [[Crimson Badlands]]. {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Corrupted Lake.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] || [[File:Hollow Wood Outskirts.png|center|400px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Crimson Badlands - Corrupted Lake area || Crimson Badlands - Hollow Wood Outskirts area |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally ''disliked'' item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |love= Dwarf, Krobus, Magnus, Morgan |like= Abigail, Henchman, Lance, Marlon, Sandy }} ==Recipes== ===Crafting=== {{CraftingRecipes|header|hide=ArtisanProf}} {{:Armor Elixir|CraftingRow}} {{:Bombardier Elixir|CraftingRow}} {{:Haste Elixir|CraftingRow}} {{:Hero Elixir|CraftingRow}} {{CraftingRecipes|footer}} ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== 60 Void Souls are required to complete Krobus' [[Quests|Void Soul Retrieval]] quest. ==Tailoring== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in tailoring or in dye pots. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced {{Navbox Forage}} [[Category:Forage]] [[zh:虚空灵魂]]
